responsibility: Sole owner of recovery_attempts: records the lineage from one verified replacement-required operational assessment to the fresh child task contract and execution-input binding issued for its replacement attempt, without claiming execution or granting authority to act.
mutation_interface: RecoveryAttemptAuthority.record appends at most one immutable attempt per assessment; verify, for_assessment and for_child are read-only
execution_location: in-process deterministic recomputation over append-only authority; no model, network, candidate execution or host action
failure_boundary: fail_closed — an assessment that is missing, malformed, or not disposed to require a replacement; a parent or child task contract or execution-input binding that fails to independently verify; a child that is not fresh, targets a different module or template, fails to preserve a required field, or does not actually change the candidate; a recovery generation beyond the fixed bound; or a retry naming a different child than the one already recorded all refuse before any row is appended
recovery_behavior: Idempotent by assessment — an identical retry verifies and returns the existing attempt, while append-only SQL and a per-assessment uniqueness check prevent replacement or reinterpretation
replacement_contract: A replacement must independently recompute the assessment, parent and child task-contract and execution-input facts rather than trust a caller's assertion, preserve every field the assessment declares preserved bit-for-bit, require the candidate to have actually changed, enforce the fixed generation bound, remain the only writer of recovery_attempts, and remain unable to authorize, execute, verify, review, or promote anything
evidence_produced: one content-addressed recovery_attempts row per declared recovery attempt
a forward link from assessment to the child authorization, task contract and execution-input bindings issued for the attempt
a refusal naming any unpreserved field, unchanged candidate, or exceeded generation bound
